death.mythic_relic.regression.expired: The regression ended - you truly die now
commentary.mythic_relic.respawn: Dead again? ...no matter. The chaos within you has not scattered yet. Get up.
commentary.mythic_relic.wither: The Wither? A wisp of spite I snuffed out without a thought, long ago. Still, you made me look twice.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.element_ext: That iron contraption... it takes everything apart down to its origin. Humans do so love such things.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.chaos_trace: A trace of chaos. Faint as a candle - yet it is, unmistakably, the scent of me left upon this world.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.chaos_fragm: A shard - chipped off my own seal. You picked it up without a flicker of guilt, didn't you.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.chaos_cryst: A crystal. You have set my power into stone... bold of you.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.nidhogg_mar: My mark. Wear it, and you become the only thing in this world I still hold to.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.death_trace: The breath of death. This does not smell of chaos - it smells of... ending itself.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.death_fragm: A fragment of the dead. Do not hold it too long; it will take your warmth with it.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.death_cryst: Ending, crystallised. Even I would rather not touch it.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.death_heart: ...a heart. A heart that still beats backwards. Where did you get this?
commentary.mythic_relic.item.rift_feathe: A feather that tears space itself... you have learned to take shortcuts. Do not lean on it too much - it will not carry you anywhere truly vast.
tooltip.mythic_relic.rift_feather.1: Right-click: teleport to where you look (up to %d blocks)
tooltip.mythic_relic.rift_feather.2: Sneak right-click: open the coordinate menu and travel anywhere within %d blocks

tooltip.mythic_relic.hegni_sword.4: Once the blade has accepted you, you are permanently immune to Wither
tooltip.mythic_relic.hegni_sword.5: Pulled from a cursed altar after a hundred strikes
hegni.mythic_relic.already_claimed: The blade no longer knows you - one sword to a bearer.
hegni.mythic_relic.claimed: The sword comes free - the curse of Hegni is yours now.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.hegni_sword: Hegni's blade? You actually pulled it from the stone... The spite on that thing is older than I am. Keep it. It knows you now.
tooltip.mythic_relic.prism_mirror.1: Right-click: open a %s-second Prism Deflection window
tooltip.mythic_relic.prism_mirror.reflec: - Sourced damage is reflected back at the attacker in full
tooltip.mythic_relic.prism_mirror.immune: - Unsourced damage and self-inflicted damage are simply ignored
tooltip.mythic_relic.prism_mirror.auto: In an accessory slot, it opens automatically below %s health
tooltip.mythic_relic.prism_mirror.source: Crafted from 5 Prism Energy Fragments + 4 Space Energy Fragments
mirror.mythic_relic.activated: Prism Deflection unfolds - for the next sixty seconds, whatever is aimed at you goes back the way it came.
mirror.mythic_relic.auto: Prism Deflection unfolds on its own - you were about to break.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.space_trace: A thread of space. Thin as a window not yet broken - you humans must take even "distance" apart to see what it is.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.space_fragm: A shard of space. To you it is a step away; to me, it is not enough room to turn over in.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.space_cryst: Space set into crystal. Holding "distance" in your palm... humans will bridle everything.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.prism_trace: A splinter of light. Even what is locked inside glass, you manage to wring out.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.prism_fragm: A shard of prism. It only returns what is shone upon it - it will never show you what you are.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.prism_cryst: Light crystallised. Bright enough - yet it cannot shine through the chaos you carry.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.prism_mirro: A mirror. Returning what is struck at you, unchanged - that temper looks borrowed from me. Only remember: the one in the glass is you.
tooltip.mythic_relic.poison_ring.1: A ring in an accessory slot that grants immunity to every negative effect
tooltip.mythic_relic.poison_ring.block: - Wither, poison, weakness, slowness... no harmful effect can be applied
tooltip.mythic_relic.poison_ring.cleanse: - Existing harmful effects on you are slowly cleansed away
tooltip.mythic_relic.poison_ring.source: Crafted by arranging 8 Toxic Energy Fragments in a ring
tooltip.mythic_relic.mythic_book.1: Right-click to open this ancient tome
tooltip.mythic_relic.mythic_book.flavor: A manuscript of unknown origin, copied by unknown hands.
tooltip.mythic_relic.mythic_book.flavor2: A book + obsidian crafts another copy.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.toxic_trace: Spider eyes, pufferfish, poisonous potato - there is an honest thing on them: they never pretend. The trace is the shallowest layer.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.toxic_fragm: A fermented spider eye - the poison goes one layer deeper. The fragment is not for eating; it is the bone of that ring.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.toxic_cryst: A crystal grown from a wither rose. Wither is something I look down on - but the flower has a backbone I can respect.
commentary.mythic_relic.item.poison_ring: Eight fragments of poison arranged in a ring. The middle is empty - and that emptiness is exactly what nothing can get into. Wear it, and nothing can harm you. But I wonder: is someone who never falls ill still alive?
commentary.mythic_relic.item.mythic_book: A copied manuscript. Some of what is written in it is true. As for the rest... who knows.
book.mythic_relic.page.2:
THE MYTHIC BOOK
A guide to everything in Mythic Relics. You start with one; if it is lost, craft one from a Book + Obsidian.
Entries are grouped by volume; click an entry to jump, or use "< Contents" to go back.
book.mythic_relic.page.3:
ELEMENT EXTRACTOR
Breaks things back down to their origin: feed it materials, get energy traces or fragments out.
Craft: 5 Obsidian + Piston + Hopper. 1 input slot, 3 output slots; each run takes 8-20 s.
All extraction recipes are in JEI; sources are also listed in each material entry.
book.mythic_relic.page.4:
CHAOS ENERGY
Trace / Fragment / Crystal - one thing at three purities.
Obtained by extracting Ender Pearls, Chorus Fruit, End Stone, End Crystals and more.
Upgrade: 9 Trace > 1 Fragment; 9 Fragments > 1 Crystal.
Use: eat it for chaos progress (+10/+40/+150); Crystal also crafts the Altar and the Runes.
book.mythic_relic.page.5:
DEATH ENERGY
Trace / Fragment / Crystal - cold-white ending. A raw material; it gives no chaos progress.
Obtained by extracting Bone, Skeleton Skull, Soul Sand, Soul Soil, Nether Bricks; a Wither Rose yields 3 Fragments.
Upgrade: 9 Trace > 1 Fragment; 9 Fragments > 1 Crystal.
Use: the core material of the Heart of Death.
book.mythic_relic.page.6:
SPACE ENERGY
Trace / Fragment / Crystal - "distance", drawn out of Ender Pearls and Chorus Fruit.
Obtained by extracting Ender Pearls or Chorus Fruit; it comes out alongside chaos traces.
Upgrade: 9 Trace > 1 Fragment; 9 Fragments > 1 Crystal.
Use: the Rift Feather needs 1 Crystal; the Prism Mirror needs 4 Fragments.
book.mythic_relic.page.7:
PRISM ENERGY
Trace / Fragment / Crystal - light locked inside glass.
Obtained by extracting colorless Glass for Trace; Stained or Tinted Glass for Fragment (Tinted Glass yields 2).
Upgrade: 9 Trace > 1 Fragment; 9 Fragments > 1 Crystal.
Use: the Prism Mirror needs 5 Fragments.
book.mythic_relic.page.8:
TOXIC ENERGY
Trace / Fragment / Crystal - the most honest energy: it says you die, and you die.
Obtained by extracting Spider Eye, Pufferfish (2 Traces each), Poisonous Potato, Fermented Spider Eye (1 Fragment), Wither Rose.
Upgrade: 9 Trace > 1 Fragment; 9 Fragments > 1 Crystal.
Use: the Ring of Immunity needs 8 Fragments.
book.mythic_relic.page.9:
CHAOS ALTAR
An altar hewn from obsidian. Craft: 8 Obsidian + 1 Chaos Crystal.
It does not start the ritual - the ritual begins on its own the moment you step into the Sealed Land.
Its only use: right-click to send you back to your spawn (Sealed Land only, as an escape).
book.mythic_relic.page.10:
SEALING RUNE
Bricks carved with ancient sigils. Craft: 8 Gilded Blackstone + 1 Chaos Crystal, yields 8.
A purely decorative block for altar scenery.
During the sealing ritual the runes on the field are drawn in one by one, 110 in all.
book.mythic_relic.page.11:
THE SEALED LAND
When the Ender Dragon dies, a Chaos Key floats up above the End altar.
Right-click an End Gateway with the key to enter the Sealed Land.
Stepping in begins the sealing ritual; watch it through to receive the Mark of Nidhogg. Leaving early breaks it - carry the key in again to retry.
book.mythic_relic.page.12:
MARK OF NIDHOGG
The final product of the sealing ritual. In an accessory slot it binds: it cannot be removed, and is kept on death.
Eating chaos energy builds progress, unlocking four tiers in order: Greed/Gluttony/Origin passives > the Shadow Dragon Blade and dragon-wing glide > glide thrust and hover > press R to unleash the Chaos Domain (further progress becomes max health).
book.mythic_relic.page.13:
RIFT FEATHER
A feather that tears space open. Craft: 4 Ender Pearl + 4 Feather + 1 Space Crystal.
Right-click: teleport to where you look, up to 1000 blocks.
Sneak right-click: open the coordinate menu to land anywhere within 1000 blocks.
Cooldown 2 s; landing in mid-air grants Slow Falling so you do not fall to your death.
book.mythic_relic.page.14:
SWORD OF HEGNI
Set in the stone of the Cursed Altar; it takes a hundred strikes to draw, and accepts only one owner.
Base attack 20, plus 3% of the target's max health; on hit it curses them - they cannot heal and totems of undying fail; the one who draws it is permanently immune to Wither.
Structure: /locate structure mythic_relic:hegni_altar
book.mythic_relic.page.15:
PRISM MIRROR
Craft: 5 Prism Fragment + 4 Space Fragment.
Right-click: open a 60 s deflection - sourced damage is reflected back at the attacker; sourceless damage (falls, fire, the void) is ignored entirely.
In an accessory slot: auto-activates below 5 health (2.5 hearts); cooldown 60 s.
book.mythic_relic.page.16:
RING OF IMMUNITY
Craft: 8 Toxic Fragments in a ring.
Once in an accessory slot: Wither, Poison, Weakness, Slowness and every other harmful effect cannot be applied.
Any harmful effect already on you is cleansed, one layer every 1 s, until you are clean.
book.mythic_relic.page.17:
HEART OF DEATH
Craft: 9 Death Crystal + 1 Nether Star.
Once in an accessory slot: reaching zero health does not kill you - health turns negative and holds for 5 minutes.
Pull it back above zero within those 5 minutes to survive; otherwise the regression ends and you truly die. Cooldown 5 minutes.
book.mythic_relic.page.18:
EPILOGUE
Every word you heard in the Sealed Land came from Nidhogg's own mouth. What this book records is the world as it sees it.
Where the text differs from the game, trust the game. Press V to open your accessories.
